first.rationale: Prioritize a focused onboarding-simplification experiment because onboarding completion is declining and inherited evidence indicates shortening onboarding improved completion, time-to-value, and early adoption, while signup simplification durably improved SMB activation. Verify the underlying onboarding and activation-messaging records before finalizing design. Avoid broad promotional pricing despite competitive pressure because prior evidence found a material 30-day retention reduction, which conflicts with the long-term qualified-revenue objective.
